issues.summary: Automate validation of the legacy-to-new product hierarchy mapping
issues.description:
Add a pre-close validation step that fails loudly when SKUs exist without a mapped category node in the current hierarchy. The March close failure was detected only when the valuation job produced no output partition, which is too late to protect the close calendar.

Scope: detection only. This does not address ownership of the mapping table - see SCRG-4472.
acceptance_criteria: Validation runs before the valuation job and reports unmapped SKU count
Non-zero unmapped count blocks the valuation job and notifies the data platform on-call
Result is recorded against the close checklist

issues.summary: Assign ownership of the hierarchy mapping table and require a reviewer for changes
issues.description:
The legacy-to-new hierarchy mapping table has no registered owner. Merchandising believes the data platform owns it because it is consumed there; the data platform believes Merchandising owns it because it is master data. No reviewer is required for changes, so drift is undetected until a downstream job fails.

This ticket addresses the control failure identified on 3 April. SCRG-4471 addresses only the detection gap.
acceptance_criteria: A named owner is registered for the mapping table in the service catalogue
Changes to the mapping require an approving reviewer from the owning team
The manual override applied on 1 April is either persisted to the master or reverted with a documented decision
